d0.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin where the `D0` output of the Wiegand's interface connects.

*See also: [Wiegand keypad and tag reader](https://esphome.io/components/wiegand#configuration-variables)*

d1.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin where the `D1` output of the Wiegand's interface connects.

*See also: [Wiegand keypad and tag reader](https://esphome.io/components/wiegand#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this device for use in lambdas.

*See also: [Wiegand keypad and tag reader](https://esphome.io/components/wiegand#configuration-variables)*

on_key.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a key has been pressed on the pad. The key is in a variable called `x`.

*See also: [Wiegand keypad and tag reader](https://esphome.io/components/wiegand#configuration-variables)*

on_raw.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform for any data sent by the device. The value is in a variable called `value`, the number of bits is in a variable called `bits`. Note that this will include parity bits as well and no parity checking is done.

*See also: [Wiegand keypad and tag reader](https://esphome.io/components/wiegand#configuration-variables)*

on_tag.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a Wiegand-compatible card or a tag has been read by the device. The tag code is in a variable called `x`.

*See also: [Wiegand keypad and tag reader](https://esphome.io/components/wiegand#configuration-variables)*
